summary: CAMB.AI Startup Grants provide approved early-stage startups up to 33M characters of MARS Text-to-Speech API credits plus engineering support. The page headlines 33M characters, while the application invitation says “up to 33 million”. Eligibility: pre-seed through Series A, founded within the last five years, under $5M raised, building a product that uses voice, speech, or localization AI, and no previous CAMB.AI program credits.
claim_steps: Fill out the application form at camb.ai/startup-grants with company details and what you are building.
CAMB.AI reviews the submission and replies; approved teams receive up to 33M characters of credits and an onboarding call with engineering.

social_proof.title: Join our Startup Program | CAMB.AI
social_proof.text: Get 33M characters in Speech AI credits. Build and deploy production-ready voice AI with credits for our MARS Text-to-Speech APIs, plus direct access to our engineering team. Early-stage startup (pre-seed through Series A), founded within the last 5 years, raised under $5M in total funding.
